recipes.name: The Every-Meat Burrito inspired by Regular Show: 2 Million Subscriber Special
instructions: For the Chicharron
Cover meat in baking soda and salt and refrigerate on a rack for 2-24 hours. - Pork belly - Baking soda - Salt
Once removed from the fridge, cut the pork belly into half inch pieces.
Place the meat in a wok and barely cover with water, bring to a boil, and skim off any scum that comes to the surface for the next 2-4 hours.
Cook down until pork belly is rendering in its own fat.
For the Spice Paste
Boil the guajillo and pasilla chiles for about 15 minutes or until they're nice and soft. - 5 guajillo chiles - 5 pasilla chiles
Strain them and reserve their boiling liquids.
Remove the seeds from each pepper.
Return the peppers to the liquid once they’ve been deemed seedless.

Add peppers to a high powered blender with a shake of onion powder, a few cloves of fresh garlic, a little shake of cumin powder, a generous pinch of Mexican oregano, and a spirited sprinkling of freshly ground annatto seeds - Onion powder - 3 cloves of garlic - shake of cumin - Mexican oregano - Ground annatto seeds
Blend on high for about 1 minute.
For the Al Pastor
Break down pork shoulder into slices no thicker than ¼ inch. - Pork Shoulder
Once broken down, add pork to a bowl along with spice paste marinade and gently massage until all the meat is coated.
Cover bowl in tin foil and place in the fridge for 2-3 hours.

Cut the pineapple at the bottom so you have a piece that is about 2 inches tall. Place two bamboo skewers next to each other. Place meat over the skewers making a makeshift shawarma. - Pineapple - Bamboo skewers
Cut the top of the pineapple and place that on top.
Place in a 350°F oven, right up against the side wall of the oven, rotating frequently to get that charred shawarma effect.
Remove from oven and shave off meat much like a shawarma, and set aside.
For the Carnitas
Preheat oven to 275°
Add carnitas to a baking dish. - Carnitas
Cut one orange into quarters and squeeze the juice over the carnitas. Take the squeezed orange flesh and add to the mixed meat mixture. - 1 orange
Add serrano peppers (halved) to the mixture along with a whole onion (chopped), a generous pour of vegetable oil, kosher salt, and pepper. - 2 Serrano peppers halved - Vegetable oil - Salt - Pepper
Also add fresh bay leaves, garlic (halved), and cinnamon sticks. - 4 bay leaves - 6 whole cloves halved - 2 sticks cinnamon
Mix everything together and cover in tin foil.
Place in the oven for 3 ½ hours.
Once cooked, uncover, and remove meat from spices. Start shredding until all carnitas is shredded.
Set aside and refrigerate until needed.
For the Rice

Take boiling water, adding squeezed limes and a shake of cumin along with long grain white rice in a casserole tightly covered with aluminum foil and bake for 20-25 minutes at 400°F. - 2 cups long grain white rice - 2 limes - shake of cumin - 3 cups water
For the Burrito
Cook some bacon in a pan. Remove bacon and use the fat to crisp up Chicharron and carnitas. - Bacon
Take a large tortilla and spread down a base layer of white lime rice and a few slices of our chorizo sausage. - Big tortillas - Chorizo

Next add the crispy chicharron and carnitas. Then comes the al pastor. Top that with some monterey jack cheese, salsa, sour cream and bacon. - Chicharron - Carnitas - Al pastor - Monterey jack cheese - Salsa - Sour cream
